name: LC Detail Daemon (modes)
plain: A rewrite of the Detail Daemon idea with the CFG multiplier removed and two extra modes. In look only, the answer is rescaled back to the real noise level. In keep structure, it runs the model twice and only keeps the high-frequency part of the difference.
math:
σ_model = σ·max(1e-6, 1 − 0.1·m).
classic: use D(x,σ_model).
look only: D' = x − (σ/σ_model)·(x − D(x,σ_model)).
keep structure: d = D(x,σ_model) − D(x,σ); D' = D(x,σ) + (d − blur(d)), blur is a twice-applied [1,2,1]/4 kernel.

props.params: amount, start, end, peak, exponent, mode

providers.author: lonecatone23
providers.note: no CFG multiplier; added look only and keep structure
